content:
I'm writing to advertise a one-year postdoctoral position (which could also be adapted for someone who does not have a PhD) in formalizing higher category theory in any proof assistant. This is funded by the US Air Force Office of Scientific Research and could be structured as a full time remote position:

https://www.mathjobs.org/jobs/list/28481

From the job announcement:

The successful candidate will be part of the team working on the grant “Proof assistants for formalization of higher category theory.” Specific work will involve the formalization of results from (infinity,1)-category theory in the candidate’s choice of various computer proof assistants — Lean, Rzk, and Agda — continuing ongoing formalization efforts. The candidate will collaborate with Emily Riehl and assume a leadership role in expanding the formal theory of (infinity,1)-categories.

Prior experience in computer formalization and some background in higher category theory are essential qualifications for this project.

For a Lean user, the ideal candidate would be someone who is interested in assuming a leadership role in the infinity-cosmos project, which would involve both contributing formal code but also adapting/extending the blueprint to make it easier for others to also contribute.

The application is intentionally light weight:

Applicants are asked to submit a standard AMS coversheet, a CV in any format, a 1–3 page cover letter describing their qualifications and interest in the proposed project, and one letter of reference. Applications received by June 30, 2026, will be given full consideration.

DM me if you have any questions.
